summary: Backend-only testing of AI capture consistency fix + admin extraction-trace endpoint. All 19 tests PASS (6 regex unit tests + 13 HTTP integration tests). Ramakant labeled-layout bug is confirmed fixed end-to-end through /api/extension/ai-extract.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/extension.py is 2904 lines — recommend splitting into ai_extract.py / capture.py / enrichment.py for maintainability (File Size policy violation >700 lines).
routes/extraction_trace.py correctly excludes mongo _id via projection {'_id': 0} (good).
Admin gate in extraction_trace.py is tied to literal 'admin@vhc.in' — if another admin is added later, they will not be able to read traces. Consider config-driven allow-list.

/api/extension/ai-extract records trace ONLY when has_name AND has_contact are both true (line 605). If only a name is DOM-extracted and the raw_text lacks email/phone, no trace row is written — worth documenting for admins debugging 'no trace appears' cases.
record_trace_async is fire-and-forget with asyncio.create_task and no error handler on the task itself; silent failures will only surface through the internal try/except in record_trace_async.
seed_data_creation: None — tests use in-memory fixtures; trace rows auto-expire via 72h TTL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New integration suite at /app/backend/tests/test_ai_extract_api.py covers (a) all 3 Naukri layouts on /api/extension/ai-extract, (b) full admin/non-admin/unauth matrix for /api/debug/extraction-trace, (c) trace auto-record verification, (d) /api/health, (e) /api/extension/capture regression. IMPORTANT: trace writes only fire when has_name AND has_contact are both true in /ai-extract — if writing future trace tests, include dom_extracted_email+dom_extracted_phone in payload, otherwise the trace row is skipped.
